comparison.objective: Play a prescribed two-hand keyboard passage with distinct dynamics and timing; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires simultaneous soft and loud key presses, sequencing, release timing, and steady tempo. Candidate requires precision hex-tool use, collar manipulation, locking, and iterative physical testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the exact note order, synchronized bass, velocity separation, even tempo, key releases, and hand clearance. Candidate requires two safe, repeatable impact stops under mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: No meaningful objective, manipulation, or outcome overlap exists.
